{{Quote|We're talking of revenge, Roblio! That's not the path of a Jedi! Having lost so much, must we now give that up as well?|Bultar Swan, to Roblio Darté|<ref name="Purge" />}}
'''Bultar Swan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] with and served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the final [[Time/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. As a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Micah Giiett]], Swan excelled at [[Unarmed combat/Legends|martial arts]], and she later complemented her fighting techniques with a strong [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] defense under the tutelage of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]. Dedicated to her beliefs, she was respected within the Order for her record of never having [[Death/Legends|killed]] an opponent prior to the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After [[Knighting Ceremony/Legends|becoming]] a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], Swan was routinely sent on peace missions, including [[Mission to Fondor (Separatist Crisis)|one]] to the [[Fondor system/Legends|Fondor system]] to investigate the alleged reappearance of an [[Sun Runner|ancient starship]] and to mediate a dispute over salvage rights to the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]]. Swan became entwined in a plot by the shipbuilder [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] to destroy the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]], and she aided in destroying Groodo's [[Droid Control Army]] and thwarting his plan to take over [[Fondor Spaceport]].

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Swan was [[Third mission to the Sepan sector|dispatched]] to the [[Sepan system/Legends|Sepan system]] to negotiate the cessation of a decades-long [[Sepan Civil War|civil war]], and later in the year, she joined a massive [[Jedi assault team/Legends|Jedi strike team]] that was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] to rescue [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|two]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Jedi]] and a [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Republic Senator]], who were due to be executed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|ensuing battle]] launched a three-year [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict known as the [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] Wars, during which Swan served the Republic as a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]]. She led Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|forces]] into battle on [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] such as [[Aargonar/Legends|Aargonar]] and [[Amaltanna/Legends|Amaltanna]]; a [[Battle of Amaltanna/Legends|battle]] on the latter world saw all of her troops die at the hands of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]. However, Swan was able to afterward trap Separatist [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Edi Wedd]] inside of his [[Impregnable (fortress)|impregnable fortress]] and leave him to die. Three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[19 BBY/Legends|into the war]], she helped [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|defend]] the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], from the invading [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]].

Shortly after the Confederacy fled Coruscant, the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] brought an [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end]] to the war and [[Order 66/Legends|ordered]] Republic [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] to kill their Jedi Generals. Swan escaped the initial stages of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], and she was soon contacted by fellow survivor [[Shadday Potkin/Legends|Shadday Potkin]], who invited her to a [[Conclave on Kessel|meeting]] on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. Eight Jedi attended the conclave, but Potkin had called on them with an ulterior motive: the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader, serving [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine of the reorganized [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], was on his way, and Potkin hoped that the combined strength of eight Jedi could defeat him. Vader stormed the meeting and began killing the gathered Jedi, but was soon [[Shiim/Legends|wounded]] and [[Cho mai/Legends|disarmed]] by Swan and Master [[Tsui Choi/Legends|Tsui Choi]]. Although Swan refused to kill her unarmed opponent, her fellow Jedi [[Koffi Arana]] was determined to finish their foe. He seized Swan's [[Bultar Swan's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], [[Shiak|stabbing]] her with it in the process and ending her life.

==Biography==
===Early life and Jedi training===
{{Quote|If I may ask&hellip; when you sleep, do you ever have visions of your home world or your family?''"<br />"''I was raised at the Jedi Temple. My home has always been with the Jedi.|Anakin Skywalker and Bultar Swan|<ref name="Hostage Princess">''[[Star Wars Adventures 3: The Hostage Princess]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Curve.jpg|thumb|left|Bultar Swan]]
Bultar Swan, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]],<ref name="databank" /> was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]<ref name="Order 66" /> during the final [[Time/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She displayed a high level of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force sensitivity]] at an early age and was discovered by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] separated her from her family and brought her to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to begin [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] with their order, and after several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of studying in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], Swan was assigned to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Micah Giiett]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].<ref name="ff" /> Under Giiett's guidance, Swan displayed prowess in a number of combat disciplines,<ref name="databank" /> including [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]] and the [[Verdanaian "sliding hands"]].<ref name="ff" /> The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] Jedi Master [[Anoon Bondara]] aided Giiett in teaching Swan to blend the two [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]] styles.<ref name="PotJ" />

Giiett was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]] extremists during the [[Yinchorri Uprising]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]],<ref name="actsofwar">[[Jedi Council: Acts of War 4|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'' 4]]</ref> and Swan continued her training under Jedi Master [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], a longtime friend of Giiett's. Koon placed greater emphasis on practicing [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] than Giiett had, and helped Swan learn to use [[Lightsaber/Legends|the weapon]] to complement her skills in martial arts. He took her to [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]] to visit the site of Giiett's death, and told her that her former Master had sacrificed his life in order to save several other Jedi. Although she still heavily felt his loss, Swan [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] that Giiett had been at peace at the time of his death and believed that he would have been proud of what she had accomplished in her training.<ref name="PotJ" />

===Knighthood===
{{Quote|He still has much to learn.''"<br />"''Then I hope he's a fast learner.''"<br />"''And why is that?''"<br />"''Because we may need a great deal of strength if we're going to prevent a civil war.|Obi-Wan Kenobi discusses Anakin Skywalker with Swan during their mission to the Fondor system|<ref name="Sun Runner">''[[Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner]]''</ref>}}
Swan was [[Knighting Ceremony/Legends|knighted]] within the following eleven years, and entered active service as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] in a [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] growing more dangerous.<ref name="ff" /> Shortly before [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Swan's jurisdiction as a Knight included the [[Fondor system/Legends|Fondor system]],<ref name="Screaming Skulls">''[[Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls]]''</ref> and she was called on to [[Mission to Fondor (Separatist Crisis)|mediate a dispute]] between [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Rodd]] of the planet [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] and [[Margravine]] [[Quenelle]] of the world's [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Nallastia]]. A [[Fondorian]] patrol [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and a Nallastian [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] had both disappeared after encountering what appeared to be the ''[[Sun Runner]]'', a starship that had been missing for four thousand [[Galactic Standard Calendar|years]]. Both Rodd and Quenelle were claiming salvage rights to the ship, and Swan spent a few [[Standard day/Legends|days]] aboard the [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Fondor Spaceport]] contacting her sources on Fondor and Nallastia in an effort to learn more about the situation.<ref name="Sun Runner" />

[[File:Bultar_Swan_profile.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Bultar Swan served the Galactic Republic as a Jedi Knight.]]
She was able to convince Rodd and Quenelle to allow further Jedi mediation instead of sending armed vessels to the site of the derelict ''Sun Runner'', and Jedi Knight [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his Padawan [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were dispatched to assist her. They arrived at Fondor [[Spaceport/Legends|Spaceport]] in the [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|Republic cruiser]] ''[[Unitive]]'' and brought Swan to the site of the derelict ''Sun Runner''. She briefed them on the situation during the journey through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], and when the ''Unitive'' arrived at the deep-[[Realspace/Legends|space]] rendezvous point, Rodd's [[salvage hauler]] and Quenelle's [[rescue runner]] awaited them. The Senator and the Margravine both boarded the ''Unitive'' and joined the Jedi in the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser's]] salon pod. Swan sat with them at a round table as they argued over the salvage rights, but when both refused to budge, she appealed to Kenobi for help. His deciding judgement, which he was on the verge of presenting, was forestalled when the cruiser's lights went out and a ship-wide power surge fried every onboard system.<ref name="Sun Runner" />

[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Pietrangelo]] found the group and explained that the surge had been caused when the ''Sun Runner''{{'s}} [[Engine/Legends|engines]] fired, and Swan put an end to the negotiations in order to stop the ancient ship and rescue any potential innocents trapped aboard. Senator Rodd led the Jedi through a [[Docking tube/Legends|docking tube]] to his ship, where a [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]] and [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] awaited them. None of the [[Environment suit/Legends|pressure suits]] were an appropriate size for Swan, which prompted her to remain behind and watch over the squabbling [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] while Kenobi and Skywalker infiltrated the ''Sun Runner''.<ref name="Sun Runner" /> After several of the ''Unitive''{{'s}} systems were brought back online, Swan received a message from [[Fondor Space Patrol]]: The missing freighter and patrol ship had recently returned and docked at Fondor Spaceport. Accompanied by the diplomats' ships, the ''Unitive'' jumped to [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]].<ref name="Screaming Skulls" />

The three vessels docked at the spaceport concurrently with Kenobi's Headhunter. He revealed that the vessel had in fact been a [[False Sun Runner|false ''Sun Runner'']], and that he and Skywalker had destroyed it with a [[Hypermatter reactor/Legends|hypermatter reactor]]-planted [[Proton grenade/Legends|proton grenade]] after discovering that it had been on a crash course with Fondor. Skywalker's CloakShape [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] had plummeted toward Nallastia during the melee, and Kenobi had only come to the spaceport to [[Fuel/Legends|refuel]] before pursuing him. Quenelle offered the two Jedi a ride to the surface aboard her [[Nallastian V-wing|shuttle]], and while she prepared the ship, Rodd took the opportunity to accuse Kenobi of having destroyed the real ''Sun Runner'' in a desperate attempt to prevent a Fondorian civil war.<ref name="Screaming Skulls" />

Swan and Kenobi sensed that Rodd was hiding something&mdash;little did they know that he was in league with [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]],<ref name="Screaming Skulls" /> a shipbuilding magnate who had created the false ''Sun Runner'' with the intention of crashing it into the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]] and eliminating his competition.<ref name="Sun Runner" /> Kenobi followed his instincts and contacted the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to request reinforcements. Aboard the Margravine's [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], Swan and Kenobi [[Homing beacon/Legends|homed in]] on the remains of Skywalker's crashed [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]], which they found abandoned on Nallastia's surface. Following two sets of footprints, they flew to the [[Skull Queen's fortress|fortress]] of Nallastia's [[Skull Queen]], where they found Skywalker holding the moon's [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Calvaria]] at lightsaberpoint.<ref name="Screaming Skulls" />

===Thwarting a Hutt===
{{Quote|Can you also control your nightmares?''"<br />"''Jedi don't have nightmares.''"<br />"''Of course.|Skywalker and Swan, on Nallastia|<ref name="Hostage Princess" />}}
Swan and the others departed the Margravine's shuttle, and Quenelle informed everyone present that she was the Skull Queen and Calvaria her daughter. Amidst the tense situation, Skywalker explained that Calvaria had [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] [[Hondu Firewell|Hondu]] and [[Tattyra Firewell]], the [[Zoologist/Legends|zoologist]] [[Parent/Legends|parents]] of a young boy named [[Klay Firewell|Klay]], whom she had mistaken for malicious poachers. Quenelle berated her and explained to the Jedi that the two were trapped between Nallastia's ancient [[Trinity Stones]], which would cause a [[Magnet/Legends|magnetic]] field to crush them to death in ninety [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] unless the fabled [[Lost Stars of Nallastia]] could be found and used to counteract their power. Swan, Kenobi, Skywalker, and Klay Firewell hurriedly joined Quenelle in her shuttle, which Skywalker [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] to the [[Cavern of Screaming Skulls]].<ref name="Screaming Skulls" />

When the group disembarked in front of the cavern, a giant [[Spider/Legends|spider]] appeared and fired silky filaments at the party. Swan dove in front of Firewell to protect him, but they both ended up ensnared in the web. A jolt of electricity fired through the filaments rendered them both [[Sleep/Legends|unconscious]], and Skywalker ferried them back to the fortress after Quenelle killed the spider with a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]]. Kenobi and Quenelle were able to recover the Lost Stars and save the zoologists, but Swan, after waking up, yet sensed that something was amiss in the Fondor [[Star system/Legends|system]]. After the Firewells departed for their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]], Kenobi and a recovered Swan joined Quenelle and Calvaria at a celebratory feast while Skywalker rested. During the dinner, mother and daughter both declared their intentions to [[Marriage/Legends|marry]] a confused Kenobi.<ref name="Screaming Skulls" />

[[File:BultarSwan-Republic59.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Bultar Swan, Jedi Knight]]
The Princess and the Margravine quarrelled, and the latter pointed out that her daughter was already reluctantly betrothed to Prince [[Alto]] of Nallastia's [[Raptor Clan]]. Kenobi insisted that his life was one dedicated to the Jedi, and Swan came to his rescue by explaining that only one recent Jedi, [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], had been permitted to marry due to a low birth rate on his [[Cerea/Legends|homeworld]]. Neither Calvaria nor Quenelle were swayed, and they agreed to a duel in one [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] before both storming out of the dining room. A befuddled Kenobi sent Swan to wake up his Padawan while he went to the fortress's landing field&mdash;their reinforcements had arrived.<ref name="Hostage Princess" />

An anxious Skywalker bombarded Swan with questions about [[Dream/Legends|dreams]], eventually breaking through her insistence that he seek wisdom from his Master instead and prompting her to describe what she saw whenever she [[Meditation/Legends|meditated]]. They then joined Kenobi at the landing field, where Masters [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] disembarked from their Republic cruiser and revealed that they too had sensed darkness in the Fondor system. Windu appealed to Quenelle to let go of her desire to marry Kenobi, but their discussion was interrupted by the discovery of a letter from Calvaria: she did not love Kenobi and had only hoped to distract her mother, allowing her to run away and marry the Fondorian [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] Rench, her true love.<ref name="Hostage Princess" />

A beacon on the shuttle Calvaria had stolen homed in on Fondor Spaceport. When Quenelle contacted her daughter there, she learned that the spaceport had been taken over by a group called the [[Droid Control Army]], who would issue demands in one hour. Swan, Windu, Fisto, and Quenelle decided to try to thwart them before that hour had passed, while Kenobi and Skywalker remained behind in case the takeover was a ruse. Swan and Fisto prepared the Republic cruiser while Windu and Quenelle retrieved the Lost Stars of Nallastia; with the artifacts in their possession, the group departed. The Stars' power allowed them to break through the spaceport's [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]]; after they landed in a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], Windu destroyed a modified [[GNK power droid/Legends|GNK power droid]], whose upper casing contained a [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]].<ref name="Hostage Princess" />

Due to the spaceport's sheer size, the group split up in an effort to find Calvaria and any other potential hostages. Swan made her way through the complex, eventually riding a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] into a hangar and finding both Fisto and Windu, as well as Rench and Calvaria, the latter of whom was clutched in the [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] of a modified [[FX-series medical assistant droid/Legends|FX-series medical assistant droid]]. Windu ordered Swan and Fisto to lower their weapons, but when the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] dragged Calvaria out of the hangar, Windu followed and rescued her. The Jedi remained unaware that the [[Army/Legends|army]] had belonged to Groodo, who had actually planned to send the spaceport crashing down into important factories on Fondor's surface after the hour had passed. However, the presence of the Jedi and the destruction of his army had sent the Hutt fleeing. The Jedi returned Calvaria and Rench&mdash;who was in fact Prince Alto himself&mdash;to Nallastia and took a much-needed rest.<ref name="Hostage Princess" />

Throughout the mission to Fondor, Swan learned much from Kenobi and Skywalker. Her experience made her an obvious choice for other peace missions,<ref name="ff" /> and in 22 BBY, she and fellow Knights [[Empatojayos Brand]] and [[Chellemi Chuovvick]] [[Third mission to the Sepan sector|embarked]] on one to the [[Sepan system/Legends|Sepan system]]. Their task was to negotiate the cessation of hostilities between the residents of two neighboring planets, [[Dimok/Legends|Dimok]] and [[Ripoblus/Legends|Ripoblus]], after decades of [[Sepan Civil War|conflict]] between the two enemies. The three Jedi were able to bring the civil war to a [[Standard month/Legends|month]]-long standstill, but upon their return to Coruscant, the fighting flared up again.<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|jediwatch/13328_2.html|Sepan Civil War Escalates}}</ref>

===Entering the Clone Wars===
{{Quote|This party's over.|Mace Windu, revealing to Count Dooku his Jedi strike team, of which Swan was a part|<ref name="Episode II" />}}
[[File:SwanColemanGeonosis-AOTC.png|thumb|right|300px|Swan and Jedi Master [[Coleman Trebor/Legends|Coleman Trebor]] at the Battle of Geonosis]]
In 22 BBY, the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] brought the Republic to its knees. Several thousand star systems seceded from the Republic, many of them joining the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], led by the former Jedi Master [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. When Obi-Wan Kenobi discovered that the Confederacy was building a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|army]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], he was taken captive along with Skywalker and Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was given emergency powers by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], and he commissioned a [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. As Jedi Master [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] went to [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to recruit an army of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that Kenobi had earlier discovered the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] had been secretly building for the Republic, Master Windu brought a [[Jedi assault team/Legends|Jedi strike team]] to Geonosis, Swan among them. As Kenobi, Skywalker, and Amidala stood in Geonosis's [[Petranaki arena]] surrounded by Separatist battle droids, the Jedi strike team infiltrated the arena and came to their aid, igniting their lightsabers and rushing at the droids.<ref name="Episode II" />

Swan, who had largely rejected unarmed combat by this point, charged into battle with her lightsaber drawn. All of her combat training came into play as she struggled to resist the barrage of battle droid [[Laser/Legends|laserfire]].<ref name="ff" /> Many Jedi fell to the overwhelming force of rapidly-firing droids, and Swan joined a survivor's circle in the center of the arena as the droids ceased firing and Count Dooku, observing the melee from above, called on the Jedi to surrender. Windu refused, and as the Jedi again raised their lightsabers, the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] army arrived, landing in and outside of the arena in [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]]. The surviving Jedi boarded the ships, and a [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|battle]] ensued between Republic and Separatist forces, initiating the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Swan and the other survivors joined the clones in sending Separatist forces fleeing from the planet.<ref name="Episode II" />

===On the front lines===
{{Quote|Victory is always complicated.|Ki-Adi-Mundi, after troops under his and Swan's command defeated Separatists on Aargonar|<ref name="SWR 59">[[Republic 59|''Republic'' 59]]</ref>}}
[[File:Battle_of_Amaltanna.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Swan's troops were routed during the Battle of Amaltanna.]]
Like many other Jedi,<ref name="Databank-Jedi">{{DB|organization|thejediorder|Jedi Order, The}}</ref> Swan became a [[Jedi General/Legends|general]] in the Republic's army, leading clone forces into battle against the Separatists. Six months after Geonosis, she led Republic forces [[Battle of Amaltanna/Legends|against]] battle droids under the command of the Separatist [[Commander/Legends|commander]]<ref name="Impregnable">{{CWACite|7|Impregnable (comic story)}}</ref> [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Edi Wedd]]<ref name="CSWE Wedd, Edi">{{CSWECite|III|323|Wedd, Baron Edi}}</ref> on [[Amaltanna/Legends|Amaltanna]]. All of the clones under Swan's command were killed while every battle droid was simultaneously destroyed in the process. As the lone survivor of the battle, Swan entered Wedd's [[Impregnable (fortress)|fortress]] and sought out the Baron. Via [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]] and [[Holocamera/Legends|holocameras]], Wedd followed Swan's every move and repeatedly taunted her, claiming that she could not reach his command chamber. During her search, Swan discovered corpses of native Amaltannans that had attempted to reach Wedd in the past.<ref name="Impregnable" />

Wedd dispatched small [[Unidentified spider droid|spider droids]] and a pair of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] to halt Swan's progress, but the Jedi Knight swiftly destroyed them all. She also destroyed the fortress' [[Communications array/Legends|communications array]] before arriving at the Baron's command chamber. Amidst more of Wedd's taunting, Swan plunged her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] into the chamber door's control panel, short-circuiting the door-opening mechanism. Swan then left the fortress, abandoning Wedd to die in an inescapable tomb.<ref name="Impregnable" /> Before the year's end, Swan was in charge of a contingent of clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] on a [[Unidentified snowy planet|snowy planet]]. When they left their [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]] and boarded an LAAT to confront Separatist droids, Swan herded the final stragglers aboard, and was reassured by the final entrant, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Banks (clone)|Banks]], that he had nowhere better to be.<ref name="The Enemy Within">''[[The Clone Wars: The Enemy Within]]''</ref>

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="kiadidb">{{DB|character|kiadimundi|Ki-Adi-Mundi}}</ref> Swan and Jedi Master [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] led Republic forces [[Battle of Aargonar (Clone Wars)|against]] the Confederacy on [[Aargonar/Legends|Aargonar]]. When Skywalker, Jedi [[General/Legends|General]] [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]], and Hett's Padawan [[Bhat Jul]] became trapped behind enemy lines, Swan lost contact with them, and Hett's troops began to give ground to the enemy. As the Republic base was overrun by battle droids, Mundi ordered Swan to hold the location until the clone troopers under his command finished gathering at nearby [[Vondar Canyon]]. A budding sandstorm prevented them from fleeing the planet, and they planned to mount a counterattack from the canyon after the storm lifted. In order to prevent the Separatists from seizing Republic supplies, Mundi further ordered Swan to disable whatever they could not take with them. The two Generals ignited their lightsabers and joined their clones in making a stand at the base.<ref name="SWR 59" />

After holding the base for a brief period of time, their forces retreated to the canyon, and Swan discovered that the ion-charged sandstorm had disabled the tracking, targeting, and communication systems of their equipment. Both Jedi boarded [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] and continued the fight from the air, hoping to get a better view of how the battle was proceeding. The onslaught of battle droids and [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tanks]] prompted Swan to order her troops to fall back, but her instructions were preempted by the arrival of Skywalker and Hett in a [[Gunship Bomber]] Enhanced closely pursued by a [[Gouka dragon]]. Their arrival shifted the tide of the battle, and the broken lines of the Confederate troops fell to the more focused Republic forces.<ref name="SWR 59" />

[[File:Swanonaargonar.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Swan and Ki-Adi-Mundi lead Republic forces on Aargonar.]]
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], after three years of continuous warfare, the Separatists launched a [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|strike]] at Coruscant. General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], the [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the Confederacy's [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Armies]], brought the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] into [[Coruscant system/Legends|the system]] and began loosing [[Warship/Legends|warships]] against both military and civilian targets. His [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droids]] and [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|tri-fighters]] hammered themselves against the planet's defenses and disrupted traffic lanes; Swan, Jedi Masters [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]], and several other Jedi piloted [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Jedi interceptors]] against the attacking Separatist ships. During the battle, Grievous kidnapped [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and brought the Republic's leader aboard his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']].<ref name="LOE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> Kenobi and Skywalker, now respectively a Jedi Master and a Jedi Knight, infiltrated the warship and rescued Palpatine, killing Count Dooku and forcing Grievous and his fleet to flee in the process. Over the next few days,<ref name="rots">{{Film|III}}</ref> Swan left Coruscant and transferred to a Republic [[Medcenter/Legends|medstation]].<ref name="Purge" />

===Endgame===
{{Quote|Some do not think the Sith should be allowed to win.|Swan invites Tsui Choi to a conclave of surviving Jedi|<ref name="Purge" />}}
While Swan was at the medstation tending to wounded [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]],<ref name="Purge" /> Chancellor Palpatine revealed himself to Skywalker as Darth Sidious, [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], and reorganized the Republic into a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] with Skywalker, now named [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader, as his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]]. Sidious had been manipulating both sides of the war, and he had Skywalker [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|murder]] every member of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] and shut down all Separatist battle droids, while he himself [[Order 66/Legends|ordered]] all clone troopers to murder their Jedi generals. Jedi across the galaxy were [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|shot and killed]],<ref name="rots" /> but Swan managed to escape [[Assassin/Legends|execution]] when other healers at the medcenter warned her of the clones' order. With the war over, the remaining Jedi were scattered and leaderless. Swan was nevertheless contacted by Jedi Master [[Shadday Potkin/Legends|Shadday Potkin]]<ref name="Purge" /> a month later,<ref name="Order 66" /> who wanted to organize as many Jedi as possible into a force to counteract the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Potkin invited Swan to discuss their situation on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], but Swan traveled to [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] first and rendezvoused with Jedi Master [[Tsui Choi/Legends|Tsui Choi]]. She found him while he was killing several clone troopers who had been hunting him, and told him of Potkin's invitation. The two of them then journeyed to Kessel.<ref name="Purge" />

[[File:Bultarchoipurge.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Swan and Tsui Choi in the early days of the Great Jedi Purge]]
[[Conclave on Kessel|Arriving]] at an [[Unidentified Kessel spice mine|abandoned mine]] on the rocky planet, they were met by Potkin, who introduced them to five other Jedi that had been invited to the meeting: [[Koffi Arana]], [[Roblio Darté]], [[Jastus Farr]], [[Ma'kis'shaalas/Legends|Ma'kis'shaalas]], and [[Sia-Lan Wezz]]. A discussion began regarding the current galactic situation and their responsibilities as Jedi; though some in the room advocated hunting and killing the Sith, Swan opined that revenge was not the way of the Jedi. No consensus was reached, and Potkin, having expected such a result, revealed that she had lured Darth Vader to the meeting so that he might fall to the blades of eight Jedi. Vader then stormed the room, acting on false intelligence that had told him Kenobi would be attending the meeting, and was [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|attacked]] by everyone present save for Swan and Choi, who hung back from the carnage.<ref name="Purge" />

Vader killed [[Sia-Lan Wezz|Wezz]], Ma'kis'shaalas, and Potkin, and used Potkin's own [[Cortosis sword/Legends|cortosis blade]] to disable the lightsabers of Arana, Farr, and Darté. As he prepared to finish them, Swan and Choi emerged from hiding, respectively [[Shiim/Legends|slashing]] the Sith Lord's leg and [[Cho mai/Legends|amputating]] his sword arm. Vader surrendered to the Jedi, but a weaponless Arana suspected a trap and ordered Swan to kill him. Swan was unwilling to strike down an unarmed opponent, prompting Arana to seize her weapon, [[Shiak|stab]] her with it, and attack Vader. Swan died, and Arana was quickly killed when Vader [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] impaled him with the [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] blade. Vader took up Swan's lightsaber to continue the fight, and killed the remaining three Jedi with the aid of the newly arrived [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] of Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="Purge" /> The details of Swan's death were filed in a report by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Bow (clone stormtrooper)|Bow]]. The official records, which were modified by [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] from a [[Casualty Report: Order 66|compilation of various reports]] created by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Marcellin Wessel]], stated that Swan was killed by her fellow Jedi in a power struggle.<ref name="Order 66" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Don't give in to your anger, Master Koffi! Beware the dark side!|Bultar Swan to Koffi Arana|<ref name="Purge" />}}
[[File:Swandeath.jpg|thumb|right|120px|Swan's dedication to her Jedi ideals saw her betrayed and murdered by Koffi Arana.]]
Prior to the Clone Wars, Bultar Swan was respected within the Jedi Order for having never killed an opponent, but Swan saw it as an objective statistic rather than a point of pride. She hoped to never have to kill anyone, but if forced to, her goal was to make her opponent's death quick and painless. Although Plo Koon surmised that she would one day sit on the Jedi Council, Swan believed that she was nowhere near ready. Until she knew how she would react to murdering someone, she felt that she was unfit to sit in any kind of judgment over other Jedi. Swan felt that Micah Giiett, her deceased Master, would have been proud of her accomplishments.<ref name="PotJ" /> During the Clone Wars, Swan reacted pragmatically to the realities of the war and left the Separatist commander Edi Wedd to die in his sealed fortress.<ref name="Impregnable" />

Swan was respectful of other Jedi, and she sought the advice of her higher-ranked brethren while on the battlefield.<ref name="SWR 59" /> She was honored to have trained under esteemed Jedi Masters.<ref name="ff" /> Tactful, she left it to Obi-Wan Kenobi to share details of their mission to Fondor with his Padawan if he so wished, but she was insistent that he share every detail with Masters Windu and Fisto. Swan was stern with Padawan Skywalker when he questioned the wisdom of Kenobi, and she was not eager to deal with the 18-year-old Padawan's personal problems, insisting that he was better off asking his own Master for advice. She saw Skywalker as both an especially difficult puzzle and a dangerous creature.<ref name="Hostage Princess" /> Not always serious, Swan found Margravine Quenelle's and Princess Calvaria's desires to marry Kenobi to be quite funny<ref name="Screaming Skulls" /> and openly made a wisecrack about it while alone with Kenobi.<ref name="Hostage Princess" />

When action needed to be taken, Swan felt that further discussion was a waste of time.<ref name="Sun Runner" /> She was willing to fight for the things in which she believed,<ref name="ff" /> and she believed that revenge and anger were not the path of the Jedi. During the Great Jedi Purge, she refused to kill an unarmed opponent.<ref name="Purge" /> In the Fondor system, Swan made averting a civil war and protecting the lives of innocent civilians her highest priorities,<ref name="Sun Runner" /> and she took the brunt of an electrically charged spider attack in an effort to protect Klay Firewell, an innocent boy.<ref name="Screaming Skulls" />

Although born on Kuat,<ref name="Order 66" /> Swan thought of Coruscant's Jedi Temple as her home. When sleeping or meditating, Swan visualized wide-open spaces and fields of [[Color/Legends|color]], and when dark clouds appeared, she envisioned a wind to drive them back. The experience was very calming for her, and she found it an effective way to resist the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="Hostage Princess" /> Swan was 1.68 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall,<ref name="ff" /> and she had black [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and light skin.<ref name="databank" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Bultar Swan! You live!|Tsui Choi, surprised by Swan's survival of Order 66|<ref name="Purge" />}}
[[File:Swaninbattle.jpg|thumb|left|190px|Swan favored the use of a lightsaber during the Clone Wars.]]
Graceful, athletic,<ref name="PotJ" /> and acrobatic, Swan was a skilled Jedi Knight<ref name="databank" /> whose ability to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] was spotted at an early age. She developed an interest in unarmed combat techniques early in her Jedi training,<ref name="ff" /> and under the direction of Micah Giiett and Anoon Bondara soon excelled in a unique fighting style that blended Teräs Käsi and the Verdanaian "Sliding Hands" method. Her style required her to maintain physical contact with her foes in order to allow her to judge their next move,<ref name="PotJ" /> and her mastery of the two disciplines allowed her to defeat opponents with ease without having to kill them.<ref name="ff" /> Prior to the Clone Wars, Swan had never taken a life despite having been involved in a dozen combat encounters.<ref name="PotJ" />

When fighting an opponent, Swan would remain still and entice her foe to attack. She would then strike forward with awesome speed, blurring her complex routine of moves into a whirl of motion.<ref name="ff" /><ref name="visual">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> When Giiett was murdered and Swan's training continued under Plo Koon, the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] Jedi Master taught her to blend her style with a strong lightsaber defense. Under Koon's guidance, Swan developed a fluid and acrobatic combat style. In combat, she would use her lightsaber to block attacks while seeking an opportunity to disarm her foe. She would then rain punches and kicks on her unarmed opponent until they surrendered.<ref name="PotJ" /> Her methods in lightsaber combat were greatly influenced by her profound interest in martial arts.<ref name="Mysteries of the Jedi">''[[Star Wars: Mysteries of the Jedi]]''</ref>

When the Clone Wars began, Swan had rejected unarmed combat in favor of her lightsaber. The war saw her finally kill opponents, abandoning her<ref name="ff" /> respected<ref name="PotJ" /> record of never having taken a life.<ref name="ff" /> Swan was also skilled with various uses of the Force, such as [[Force deflection/Legends|deflecting]] blaster shots with a bare hand.<ref name="Impregnable" /> After visiting the location of Micah Giiett's death, she was able to sense that he had been at peace at the moment of his passing,<ref name="PotJ" /> and during her mission to Fondor, she could sense when both Senator Rodd and Margravine Quenelle were hiding something from her.<ref name="Screaming Skulls" /> Swan also had some piloting skills.<ref name="LOE" />

==Equipment==
[[File:BultarSwanLightsaber-FF111.png|thumb|right|300px|The hilt of Swan's lightsaber]]
Bultar Swan wore robes<ref name="Episode II" /> with a synthetic leather surcoat and a utility belt.<ref name="SWCE">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> While fighting against Edi Wedd on Amaltanna, she wore white armor in addition to her robes.<ref name="Impregnable" /> When she met Tsui Choi on Eriadu,<ref name="Purge" /> Swan wore brown pants, a belt, a white shirt, and chest armor.<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|packtype=''Star Wars'' Comic Pack|pack=#13: Koffi Arana & Bultar Swan (''Star Wars: Purge'' #1)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TACcomicpacks13.asp}}</ref> She wielded a green-bladed lightsaber with a silver hilt.<ref name="Episode II" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|According to Duursema, she and Ostrander have also discussed Jedi Knight Bultar Swan if (''Star Wars: Jedi'') extends beyond four issues&mdash;something that should please the adherents of Bultar Swan's burgeoning internet cult.|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="Comics Link">{{InsiderCite|67|Comics Link}}<!-- Love Shaak: A Jedi of a Different Color --></ref>}}
Bultar Swan was created for<ref name="databank" /> the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="Episode II" /> Artist [[Dermot Power]] created concept art of the character,<ref name="ArtOf">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> and the role was given to actor [[Mimi Daraphet]],<ref name="databank" /> who was cast by extra casting director [[Ros Breden]].<ref name="oldswcom" /> Swan's scenes in the Geonosis arena were filmed at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]], between [[August 10]] and [[August 15]], [[2000]].<ref name="Archives">''[[The Star Wars Archives: Episodes I–III, 1999–2005]]''</ref> The cut of Swan's outfit is very similar to the leather-accented ensemble worn by Anakin Skywalker in the same film.<ref name="databank" /> Prior to the release of the film, Swan was first shown on [[January 31]], [[2002]], in the [[StarWars.com]] article "Extras Extras: Ros Breden."<ref name="oldswcom">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/profile/f20020131/index.html|text=Extras, Extras: Ros Breden}}</ref> The character then made her first appearance in the [[Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones 4|fourth issue]] of Episode II's [[Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones (comic series)|comic adaptation]], written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and drawn by [[Jan Duursema]].<ref name="aotccomic">[[Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones 4|''Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones'' 4]]</ref> The issue released on [[May 8]], 2002,<ref name="aotccomicdate">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/00-477/Star-Wars-Episode-II----Attack-of-the-Clones-4|text=Star Wars: Episode II -- Attack of the Clones #4}}</ref> ahead of the film's [[May 16]], 2002 release.<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref>

[[File:Bultarconceptart.jpg|thumb|left|175px|Concept art of Bultar Swan done by Dermot Power]]
Daraphet was invited to return for [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], and she was elated to get the call, having been worried that Swan had died in Episode II. She arrived on set to undergo hair, makeup, and costume tests<ref name="Separatists & Swan">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/episode-iii/bts/setdiary/news20050605.html|series=Episode III Set Diary|text=Separatists & Swan}}</ref><ref name="Hyperspace Wordpress">{{WordPress|subdomain=swhyperspace|url=episode-iii/set-diary/|name=SW Hyperspace|text=Set Diary|archivedate=20251223144913}}</ref> in [[May]] [[2003]], although the crew in [[Wikipedia:Sydney|Sydney]], [[Wikipedia:Australia|Australia]] were working off an approximation of the shooting script<ref name="Hyperspace Wordpress" /><ref name="The Cruel Fate of Shaak Ti">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/episode-iii/bts/setdiary/news20050620.html|series=Episode III Set Diary|text=The Cruel Fate of Shaak Ti}}</ref> that did not specifically mention Swan.<ref name="Hyperspace Wordpress" /><ref name="Jedi Missing in Action">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/episode-iii/bts/setdiary/news20050627.html|series=Episode III Set Diary|text=Jedi: Missing in Action}}</ref>

The crew were hoping to be as prepared as possible for the start of production,<ref name="Hyperspace Wordpress" /><ref name="The Cruel Fate of Shaak Ti" /> and it was also felt there was enough Jedi action in the movie that calling Daraphet in was a prudent move. When the shooting scipt arrived, however, it became apparent that almost no Order 66 scenes would be filmed during the sixty days of principal photography, and Bultar Swan ultimately did not appear in the film.<ref name="Hyperspace Wordpress" /><ref name="Jedi Missing in Action" />

[[John Ostrander]] and Jan Duursema, authors of the [[Star Wars: Jedi (one-shots)|''Star Wars: Jedi'']] series of one-shot comics that were published from [[2003]] to [[2004]], considered focusing an entire issue of the series on Swan. In 2003, when discussing the comic series in the [[Star Wars Insider 67|sixty-seventh]] issue of [[Star Wars Insider|''Star Wars Insider'']], author [[Daniel Wallace]] stated that the move would have pleased Swan's "burgeoning Internet cult."<ref name="Comics Link" /> Wallace also referenced Swan in<ref name="Ladies' Night" /> the [[April 6]], 2004,<ref name="The New Face of Evil">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20040315.html|text=The New Face of Evil}}</ref> article, "[[Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night]]," published in the [[Star Wars Insider 75|seventy-fifth]] issue of ''Star Wars Insider''. Wallace joked that the character of [[Whimper Save]] narrowly edged Swan out in the "so-unofficial-we-just-made-it-up" competition of the "Best Name in Episode II" awards.<ref name="Ladies' Night">{{InsiderCite|75|Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night}}</ref>

In the 2005 comic ''[[Purge (comic book)|Star Wars: Purge]]'', Swan is killed during the Great Jedi Purge in the aftermath of the events of ''Revenge of the Sith''.''<ref name="Purge" /> Star Wars: Purge'' dates its events at one month after the events of ''Revenge of the Sith'',<ref name="Purge" /> which was established as taking place midway through 19 BBY in 2005's ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> However, in [[2006]], Keeper of the [[Holocron continuity database]] [[Leland Chee]] stated in a blog entry that Swan was killed in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].<ref name="blog">{{Blog|holocron|22/comments|Movie Characters killed in the EU}}</ref> As several other character death dates given in the blog entry are incorrect,<ref name="NEC" /><ref name="blog" /> this article treats the 19 BBY date as [[canon]]ical.
